text:
Type: color block fleece throw
Use: covering a sofa, an armchair or a bed, keeping warm; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, retro, bohemian
Materials: soft brushed fleece, contrast blanket-stitch edging
Colors: orange, teal blue, sunny yellow, pink, red, grey stitching
Shape: rectangular throw in wide bold color blocks, dark whipstitched edges, light and soft drape
Feel: cheerful, vibrant, cozy, playful
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, bright accents; colorful, eclectic or Scandinavian family rooms

product.name: VRSTJRNA
product.description: The fleece throw feels soft against your skin and can be machine washed.
